payload.reason: The evidence provides specific details on how clusters were extracted using k-means clustering on word embeddings, particularly GloVe vectors trained on Wikipedia articles.

claims.text: Clusters were extracted using k-means clustering on word embeddings, initialized with 'k-means++' and run for 300 iterations.
The clustering process involved evaluating different values for the number of clusters and minimizing cluster inertia across multiple initializations.
Word clusters have been shown to improve performance in various NLP tasks, indicating their effectiveness in feature extraction.
